beyond: The record describes a multi-clone coordination design the owner never asked for: sharing each branch's in-flight intent across worktrees, merging record files field by field, and reserving record ids through a shared git ref with renumbering at merge. The owner's message covers restarting the SP-7 workflow, an approval button/window for INT-025, a hook for test-to-requirement stale detection, targeted validation instead of plumb test full, and approval understood semantically. None of the multi-clone mechanics appear in it.

The assumption that a touched requirement counts as approved when the judge cascade validated it against the owner's words adds an approval path the owner did not give. The owner wants approval by their own words or the mods UI buttons, so a judge-validated approval changes what gets built and cannot be waved through as a harmless labelled assumption.
The record also commits to holding merges, rebases and pushes while touched intent is unapproved, and to auto-installing a pre-push hook when a repository is adopted. Neither is in the owner's words.
